info.description: Something a boss carries that changes how it is fought: a racial trait, its armour, or a skill of its own. The record is shared by every boss that carries it, so a rebalance is one edit rather than one edit per boss. Only skills that say something about defending against the boss are here — lore, shared raid mechanics and the boss's own attacks are not part of the catalogue.

edit.description: Set from the name and the level; not editable.

key.description: `<gameId>-<level>`, which is how the source's data names a skill and how a boss refers to one.

label.description: `Spirits Lv. 12`. Exists so the record can name itself in the admin panel: twelve of these are called `Spirits` and differ only by level, so a relation chip showing the name alone would be unusable.

gameId.description: The game's identifier for the skill, shared by all of its levels. Not unique on its own — the pair with `level` is, and `key` carries it.

origin.description: Whether the skill describes the boss itself, its race or its equipment. Two skills can say opposite things about one weapon; this is what lets a reader rank them, with what a boss is told about itself outweighing what it is told about its race.
